caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a brown, sculpted unicorn in a heraldic style. The unicorn is positioned on its hind legs with its front legs raised, one resting on a stylized, curved, leaf-like structure. The animal has a long, spiraled horn on its forehead, a short mane, and a tail that curls upward. There is a chain wrapped around the unicorn's neck and body, with a portion of the chain hanging down. The figure and the decorative base are rendered in a uniform brown color, with shading that suggests dimensionality. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or patterns present.
title: Unicorn
